practiceReport.name: Micah Parsons
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Explosive pass rusher who regularly manages mid-week reps and plays high-leverage third-down snaps.
factors: Season-ending Injured Reserve — ineligible to return this season
practiceReport.beatComment: Parsons remains listed as questionable for Wednesday's game against the Rams, but he's fully expected to play in Week 12 in what will mark his 2026 debut. The five-time Pro Bowler will be making his first appearance since tearing the ACL and meniscus in his left knee Dec. 14, 2025 and requiring season-ending surgery. Parsons has worked exclusively as a limited participant in practice since being designated for return from the PUP list Nov. 4, so the Packers could monitor his snaps closely in his first game action in more than 11 months.

practiceReport.name: Josh Jacobs
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Perimeter speed/cut position (RB) — requires full deceleration/burst clearance on lower-body tags (76% Questionable baseline).
factors: Consecutive Wed/Thu Limited (LP -> LP) following 2-game absence
Beat consensus: unlikely / not expected to suit up
practiceReport.beatComment: Coming off a bye week, Jacobs went down as a limited participant in all three of the team's Week 12 practice sessions. While the Packers aren't closing the door on Jacobs suiting up Wednesday, head coach Matt LaFleur previously noted Sunday and Monday that the running back was still viewed as unlikely to play against the Rams. Before making a decision on Jacobs' status prior to Wednesday's 8 p.m. ET kickoff, the Packers could put him through a pregame workout to gauge if his surgically repaired right ring finger presents any issues with gripping or securing the football. If Jacobs is forced to miss a second consecutive game, Kaleb Johnson and MarShawn Lloyd would be in line to lead the Green Bay rushing attack for another week.

practiceReport.beatComment: Moore re-injured his ankle after just three snaps on special teams in the Packers' Week 10 loss to the Vikings. His role on offense has mostly evaporated with the return of Savion Williams behind Matthew Golden and Christian Watson.

irAndReserveTracker.name: Luke Musgrave
irAndReserveTracker.byeWeekNote: Season-ending IR — ineligible to return in 2026
irAndReserveTracker.beatNote: LaFleur acknowledged that Musgrove is still in the process of rehabbing the neck injury he sustained during OTAs in June, and the Packers haven't yet prepared for the tight end to resume practicing. Barring dramatic progress in his recovery over the next month, Musgrave looks like he'll be sidelined for the final season of his rookie deal before hitting free agency in the spring.
